description: Reduce DEPTH from 8 to 6 layers, keeping ASPECT_RATIO at 64 so model_dim is 384 (divisible by HEAD_DIM 128, giving 3 heads), for faster steps and more tokens seen in the fixed time budget.
Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.02 to smooth early learning rate updates.
Increase model depth from 6 to 10 layers; with ASPECT_RATIO 64 this gives model_dim 640 (5 heads of 128), testing a larger model within the fixed time budget.
Modify weight decay for Muon parameters to linearly decay with training progress instead of staying constant.
Shorten the momentum warmup period for Muon optimizer from 300 steps to 150 steps to reach 0.95 faster.
Add gradient clipping to stabilize training and potentially allow higher learning rates for a given time budget.

description: Increasing weight decay to 0.3 increases regularization, which can stabilize high-LR training and reduce overfitting, potentially lowering val_bpb on smaller models.
Tried label smoothing but it degraded performance slightly, so this edit was aborted.
Increase TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2^17 (131K) to fit more steps in the time budget, allowing stronger updating of smaller-model parameters.
Set DEPTH to 4 and ASPECT_RATIO to 96 so model_dim stays 384 (3 heads of HEAD_DIM 128) with a shallower, wider model that gets more steps in the fixed time budget.
Set SCALAR_LR to 0.25 to test higher learning rate for per-layer scalar parameters as a potential way to speed up early training.

Tie lm_head.weight to the token embedding (wte.weight) with embedding-std init, drop the separate lm_head optimizer group, and train the shared tensor at 0.3x the embedding LR while keeping the logit softcap.
Replace the linear learning rate warmdown with a cosine-shaped warmdown to provide a smoother decay to the final learning rate.
Increase UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008 to give the unembedding layer a higher learning rate.

description: Increase the warmdown ratio to 0.7 to provide a longer, smoother learning rate decay at the end of the training budget.

Remove the value-embedding (ResFormer VE) path: the has_ve helper, per-layer value_embeds tables, ve_gate modules, their init, dtype cast, FLOP and parameter counting, optimizer group, and forward plumbing, so the freed memory and compute go to more training steps.
Reduce Muon orthogonalization iterations from 5 to 3 in the parameter group initialization.
Reduce Newton-Schulz iterations and disable Nesterov momentum in the Muon optimizer to speed up training for a given quality loss.
Set WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.7 and FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.05 to provide a longer, smoother learning rate decay for better final loss.
Sets TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2^18 to increase optimizer step count within the 300s budget, leveraging more training steps for better convergence with the fixed 384D model.
